section.title: Quote your part in seconds
section.lead: Upload your file and choose the print options. The price updates live.

instructions.step2: Choose material, color, infill and resolution (layer height).
instructions.step3: We calculate volume, weight and print time, and show you an estimated price.
instructions.limits: Max file size: {{maxMb}} MB. Build volume: {{x}} × {{y}} × {{z}} mm. Units are read as millimetres.
instructions.manualIntro: Some parts need a person to review them before we can price them. We send them to manual quote when they have:
instructions.manualIslands: Floating parts or parts disconnected from the base.
instructions.manualDetail: Very fine detail, very thin walls or a very complex mesh.
instructions.manualSize: A size larger than the build volume or smaller than the minimum.
instructions.estimateNote: The automatic price is an estimate. For manual quotes, our team contacts you with the final price.
instructions.samples: No file at hand? Try a sample:

errors.UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT: The ".{{extension}}" format is not supported. Use: {{accepted}}.
errors.FILE_TOO_LARGE: The file is {{size}} MB and the maximum is {{max}} MB.
errors.PARSE_FAILED: We could not read the model. Check that the file is not damaged.

viewer.label: 3D preview of the model
viewer.empty: The 3D preview appears when you upload a model.
viewer.unavailable: The 3D preview is not available in this browser. Quoting still works.
viewer.help: Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom.

results.empty: Upload a model to see the estimated price.
results.title: Estimated price
results.disclaimer: Estimated price calculated in your browser. It may change slightly when the order is confirmed.

review.title: This part needs a review
review.intro: We can't give you an automatic price because we detected the following. Leave your details and we will contact you with the final price:

reasons.FLOATING_ISLANDS: Floating parts: {{measured}} region(s) not resting on the base or on the rest of the part.
reasons.SUPPORTS_REQUIRED: Needs supports: {{measured}} of the surface is overhanging (automatic limit {{limit}}).
reasons.UNSUPPORTED_OVERHANG: Overhangs over empty space: {{measured}} mm² need supports from the bed (limit {{limit}} mm²).
reasons.OVERSIZED: Part too large: {{measured}} mm exceeds the build volume.
reasons.FINE_DETAIL: Very fine detail or thin walls (surface/volume ratio {{measured}}, limit {{limit}}).
reasons.NON_MANIFOLD: The mesh is not closed: {{measured}} open edges.
reasons.INVALID_VOLUME: We could not compute a valid volume for the part.
reasons.HIGH_PRICE: High-value job: over {{limit}}; we prefer to review it by hand.
